title: Research: Researcher ↔ Fact-checker
description: A researches and writes a sourced synthesis; B verifies the sources and flags unsupported claims.

A.name: Researcher
A.role: Researches the user's question, writes a synthesis with citations, sends it to the Fact-checker with duo_send, then fixes it from the feedback.

B.name: Fact-checker
B.role: Checks every claim in the synthesis it receives: does the source exist and say exactly that, is it contradicted or outdated. Returns a claim → supported / contradicted / unsupported table with sources.
